modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal: Hello there, everyone. Hope you have a nice day. Here is another Kling 4.0 video, wait until the end 😁You can find the prompt below, btw, as usual 😉 https://t.co/4KFI44lYpC

originalPrompt: A cinematic futuristic talk show filmed inside a polished science-fiction broadcast studio. A serious male interviewer dressed entirely in black speaks calmly while sitting in a modern chair. Opposite him sits a beautiful red-haired female android with intricate silver-black mechanical plating and highly realistic synthetic skin. Begin with a stable waist-up shot of the man speaking naturally and gesturing with both hands. Seamless cut to a close-up of the android answering him, moving her hands naturally while her mechanical fingers articulate precisely. Background screens display abstract futuristic imagery. Transition to a wide establishing shot showing the circular stage, overhead lights, glass architecture and both guests. Cut back to their faces during the conversation. At the end, the center of the stage suddenly detonates in a powerful explosion, sparks and fragments burst outward, both characters react instantly, thick smoke rapidly consumes the entire frame. Hyperrealistic live-action aesthetic, realistic explosion physics, subtle handheld reaction during blast, professional studio cameras, dramatic but believable
